name: 10pines-c17-customerimporter-3
title: Customer Importer 3: decouple the tests from the database
description: The nine importer tests are slow because the importer and the tests talk directly to DataBaseSession, a simulated database that sleeps on every persist and select. The student must decouple them from the database (an abstraction of the customer system with an in-memory implementation used in development and the persistent one used in the integration environment, chosen by the environment) so the tests run fast but can still run against the database.

design.notes: Introducing a test double by design rather than by mocking: extract the protocol the importer and the tests need from the session into a CustomerSystem abstraction (extract interface + generalize type), give it a persistent and a transient implementation, and select one through an Environment object; the interesting part is what flows through 'session'/'system' and moving the session's lifecycle (start/stop/transactions) into the system.
